theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by
  classical
  have hc : ∀ A : Set S, A ∈ P ∨ Aᶜ ∈ P := by grind
  have hn : ∀ A : Set S, A ∈ P → Aᶜ ∉ P := by
    intro A hA hAc
    have := hPP A hA Aᶜ hAc
    simpa using this
  let Q : Finset (Set S) := Finset.univ \ P
  have heq : P.card = Q.card := by
    apply Finset.card_bij' (fun A _ => Aᶜ) (fun A _ => Aᶜ) <;> simp_all
    · intro A hA
      have h := hc A
      rcases h with hp | hcomp
      · exact False.elim (hn A hp hA)
      · exact hcomp
    · intro A hA
      have h := hc Aᶜ
      rcases h with hp | hcomp
      · simpa using hp
      · exact False.elim (hA hcomp)
  have hsum : P.card + Q.card = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
    have : P.card + Q.card = (Finset.univ : Finset (Set S)).card := by simp [Q]
    rw [this]
    simp
  have hpos : 0 < Fintype.card S := Fintype.card_pos
  have hexp : Fintype.card S - 1 + 1 = Fintype.card S := by omega
  have hp : 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) * 2 = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
    rw [← pow_succ]
    congr 1
    omega
  omega
